english:
Scoring the required Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each while within 15 meters of 2 allies grants 25% Damage Resistance (Resist x2) for 3 seconds.

Retriggering extends the duration to 5 seconds.

Precision Hits required: 25% of the Magazine plus 1, rounded down.

source.text:
Upon scoring multiple Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each, while within 15 meters of 2 allies:

25% Damage Resist (Resist x2) for 3 seconds.
Retriggering extends the duration to 5 seconds.

Precision Hits trigger:
(25% of Magazine Size) + 1, rounded down.
